analysis_summary.calendar_partitions: PR_FRACTION_75 improved both growth and EOD drawdown in 2025; PR_FRACTION_50 and PR_FRACTION_75 improved 2026 growth while worsening drawdown; no withholding arm improved 2024 growth or drawdown.
analysis_summary.consistency: No withholding fraction dominated the control across multiple calendar partitions on both growth and drawdown.
analysis_summary.economic_value: Evidence of economic impact is clear, but evidence of robust improvement is weak and inconsistent.
analysis_summary.exposure_effect: Withholding produced thousands of sizing reductions and generally sacrificed growth at the lowest fractions, but path-dependent outcomes were non-monotonic.
analysis_summary.full_period: PR_FRACTION_50 improved ending equity versus control but increased both drawdowns; all other withholding arms reduced full-period growth and increased drawdown.
analysis_summary.next_matrix_justification: Do not advance automatically. Review mechanism diagnostics first; a second predeclared delay/threshold/loss-recovery matrix is not justified as a promotion step by these results alone.
